tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Fetch a check report by its share token, the 16 character code at the end of an orbilo.co/check/r/... link. Use this when someone pastes a report link or asks about a check that was already run, instead of checking the site again. Reports expire 30 days after the check. Works without signing in.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_monitored_sites, get_site_status · Private data: get_report · Public sink: get_report · Destructive: get_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_monitored_sites, get_site_status · Private data: get_report · Public sink: get_report · Destructive: get_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
